To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the different populations of tanycyte express different molecular markers of endocytosis, that they internalise compounds present in CSF through different mechanisms, and that they sort internalised molecules to different pathways.

the four populations of rat hypothalamic tanicytes display marked differences concerning the proteins involved in endocyotosis and transcytose and that these differences are consistent with the functional properties of these cells.
tanycytes are polarised for endocytosis, and that this polarisation is related to the type of tanycyte, the type of endocytotic pathway and the nature of the compounds internalised.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the polarized endocytotic properties of the tanycytic cell populations and their functional implications.
the polarised endocytosis/transcytosis in four populations of tanicytes and with the sorting of the endocytic material in β1, 2 tanycyts.

the study of the mechanisms by which the hypothalamic cells tanycytes internalise compounds present in the cerebrospinal fluids, and translocate them towards the portal blood, and how they can be regulated.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
α1 and α1 tanycytes have a polarised endocytotic pathway, that is, they are able to internalise molecules from the ventricular CSFs but not those present in the subarachnoid CSF.
tanycytes are a heterogeneous population of cells with different endocytic and transcytose capabilities, and that the four populations of tanocytes have different functions.
the different types of tanycytic processes are polarized for endocytosis, that β1 and β1 tanycytes are polarized for transcytosis and that α1 and α1 tanycyte are not.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
α1,2 and β1,2 populations of tanycites have a distinct polarized endocytotic machinery, whereas α1 and α1 tanycites have distinct polarized transcytotic mechanisms.

β1,2 and α1,2 cells are differentially polarised in terms of endocytosis/transcytosis, with β1,2 cells having a polarised distribution of clathrin and caveolin-1 and α1, 2 cells not having such polarisation.
tanycytes are polarised in their endocytotic/transcytotic activities.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the hypothalaminic tanycytes at least, the expression of the proteins involved in the endocytosis-transcytosis process is highly regulated and that the four populations of tanocytes show marked differences.
the four populations of hypothalamic tanicytes are endowed with different endocytotic/transcytotic properties that may be related to their different functions.
the four types of tanycyte are specialised in the uptake and the routing of molecules from CSF to the brain parenchyma.
